title: MCD & NDDB Sign MoU for 3 Compressed Bio-Gas (CBG) Plants in Delhi
summary: Converts dairy cow dung into CBG at Nangli, Ghoga-Goyla, and Ghazipur to clean Yamuna.

blocks.content: Converts dairy cow dung into CBG at Nangli, Ghoga-Goyla, and Ghazipur to clean Yamuna.

items: CBG Plant Locations: Nangli, Ghoga-Goyla, and Ghazipur waste management facilities in Delhi.
Livestock Owner Payout: Livestock owners receive ₹1 per kg of cow dung supplied.
